sse.allTypes: First option of the event type filter and its accessible label.
sse.pause: Accessible label of the button that stops the list from following new events.
sse.resume: Accessible label of the button that makes the list follow new events again.
sse.clear: Accessible label of the button that empties the event list.
sse.copyAll: Accessible label of the button that copies the events currently shown.
sse.copied: Accessible label of the copy button right after copying.
sse.noEvents: Title of the empty state of the event list.
sse.noMatches: Title of the empty state when the filters hide every event.
sse.received: {{count}} is the total number of events received.
sse.dropped: {{count}} is the number of events removed from the list.
sse.reconnecting: {{seconds}} is a number of seconds, {{attempt}} the attempt number.
sseSettings.stream: Checkbox label. Server-sent events (SSE) is a web standard for one-way streams.
sseSettings.maxEventsPlaceholder: Placeholder showing the default limit, 10000 events.
sseSettings.maxSecondsPlaceholder: Placeholder showing the default limit, 300 seconds.
status.open: State of a stream that is connected and delivering events.
status.ended: State of a stream that has finished.
streamEnd.hostedLimit: {{seconds}} is a number of seconds. The web app is the version in the browser.
